title: ✨ “The world doesn’t need a perfect mentor — it needs one who’s been broken, forgiven, and rebuilt by grace.”
paragraphs: ✨ “The world doesn’t need a perfect mentor — it needs one who’s been broken, forgiven, and rebuilt by grace.”

I mentor by letting people see me repent and surrendered to God.
Because true strength isn’t in pride… it’s in kneeling. 🙏🔥

“Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.”
— Psalm 51 : 10

🎬 SURRENDERED: THE MENTOR’S REDEMPTION
An everyday story of falling, rising, and walking again under God’s light.
